While the Gokuldham members are enjoying Makar Sankranti on the terrace, local don Pappu Bhai's henchmen arrive and order everyone to pull down their kites. They issue a strict warning: only Pappu Bhai's son, Prince, is allowed to fly kites between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM, and anyone cutting his kite will face serious trouble.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
